put.description:
Change your own password (requires old password)

Logic:
- User can only change their own password
- Must provide correct old password for verification
- Changes password in both Keycloak and database
- Old password is verified by attempting Keycloak login

Args:
- old_password: Current password for verification
- new_password: New password to set

Returns:
- message: Success message
- username: Username of the user who changed password

Reset user's password (admin operation - no old password required)

Logic:
- System admin can reset any user's password
- Tenant admin can only reset passwords for users in their tenant
- No old password required
- Changes password in both Keycloak and database

Args:
- user_id: UUID of user whose password to reset
- new_password: New password to set

Returns:
- message: Success message
- user_id: UUID of the user
- username: Username of the user whose password was reset

post.description: Filter users based on query parameters

Bulk create multiple users with Keycloak integration

Logic:
- System Admin: Can specify tenant_id for each user
- Tenant Admin: Created users inherit tenant_id
- ALL users are created with role='user'
- To make users admin, use bulk-assign-role API after creation

Returns:
- success: List of successfully created users
- failed: List of failed user creations with error messages
- success_count: Number of successful creations
- failed_count: Number of failed creations
- total: Total number of users attempted

Bulk assign roles to multiple users (only system_admin can do this)

Logic (same as single role assignment):
- Only system_admin can perform this operation
- Updates both database and Keycloak for each user
- Manages tenant_admin group membership

Returns:
- success: List of successfully updated users with role information
- failed: List of failed role assignments with error messages
- success_count: Number of successful assignments
- failed_count: Number of failed assignments
- total: Total number of assignments attempted

put.description:
Change the tenant of a user (only system_admin can do this)

Logic:
- Only system_admin can change user tenants
- Set tenant_id to null to remove user from tenant
- Provide tenant_id to assign user to a new tenant
- Validates that the new tenant exists

Args:
- user_id: UUID of the user whose tenant to change
- tenant_id: UUID of the new tenant (or null to remove from tenant)

Returns:
- user: Updated user information
- old_tenant_id: Previous tenant ID (or None)
- new_tenant_id: New tenant ID (or None)
- message: Success message

- No old password required
